scope: Synthetic loopback ASGI responses only; investigate stable Chrome/Edge network completion without changing production or research session code
baseline: Exact current ResearchSessionApi.bytes, actual chunk budget, no-store, EOF and declared-length verification

candidates.name: counted-native-bridge
candidates.path: Original fetch body -> TransformStream checks cumulative actual bytes before enqueue -> new Response(stream).arrayBuffer
candidates.hypothesis: A bounded downstream native consumer may change completion handling; original network body still streams, so success is not inferred
candidates.budget: The downstream consumer must never receive bytes above the endpoint budget; header length does not substitute for actual counting

candidates.name: worker-current-client
candidates.path: Dedicated module Worker imports exact current ResearchSessionApi and calls its unchanged bytes implementation
candidates.hypothesis: A worker fetch context may differ from the document loader; source equivalence and native worker network events must be observed

positive_controls: Both installed browsers; eight repetitions each of fixed and fixed-split responses per arm; exact size and SHA-256, no unexpected native or Playwright request failures
negative_controls: Compressed expansion with visible and hidden encoding
falsification: Any positive native loadingFailed/requestfailed, incorrect payload, accepted negative or input mutation rejects that candidate; never whitelist the known ERR_ABORTED symptom
observability: Observe original request terminals before teardown, including worker CDP target for worker requests; distinguish harness error from observed candidate failure
freeze: Versioned fresh output directories, executed harness/server and current application source hashes, dependency manifests, browser binary/version and before/after input verification
cleanup: Owned workers, contexts, browsers, loopback Vite/Python listeners and native service processes must exit; preserve reports and failures
promotion: Synthetic success alone does not qualify the real research service. Review source and cancellation/budget boundaries before changing a client; then separately freeze the actual worker/session/display/export/original-restoration run
excluded: No model inference, private photos, training, downloads, system browser/configuration changes, dependency changes, clone/tee workaround, Git commands or edits to old frozen reports
